market_summary: Across all 6 symbols during the late London session, price action remains confined inside session Value Areas and mid-channel ATR envelopes. Assets are generally suppressed below session VWAPs and EMA50 baselines, but volume is subdued (RVOL < 2.0 everywhere) and prices are testing major horizontal S/R and session low supports rather than breaking out. Without high-volume momentum or clear liquidity sweeps, all instruments warrant a disciplined HOLD pending New York cash open catalysts.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3889.49 to VAH 3913.30) and hovering directly at POC 3896.98. In LONDON_SESSION, price is trading below VWAP 3902.03 and below EMA50 3900.32 baseline. It sits mid-channel between ATR bounds 3884.77 and 3913.53. RVOL is low at 0.699 lacking yellow spike confirmation. CVD is BEARISH (-2.38 with slope -0.16) but selling has stalled at fair value POC. Price is trapped between S/R support at 3887.45 (above Session Low 3878.91) and Session High resistance at 3922.99. GEX is null. Lack of directional breakout or value area expansion dictates a HOLD.

Price is testing slightly below VAL 1.10560 (Value Area 1.10560 to 1.10636) and below POC 1.10598. In LONDON_SESSION, price is trading below VWAP 1.10594 and below EMA50 1.10602. It sits in the lower half of the ATR envelope toward lower band 1.10488. RVOL is 0.974 without yellow bar confirmation, meaning the probe below VAL lacks expansion volume and is prone to a trap. CVD is NEUTRAL (+1,480 with slope -2734.66), diverging from the downward drift. Price is testing immediate S/R support at 1.10543 just above Session Low 1.10475 (Session High at 1.10726). GEX is null. Selling directly into support without volume warrants a HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32276 to VAH 1.32378) testing VAL, well below POC 1.32349. During LONDON_SESSION, price trades below VWAP 1.32329 and below EMA50 1.32345. It is approaching the lower ATR band (1.32210). RVOL is 1.098 without yellow RVOL confirmation. CVD is BEARISH (-3,723 with slope -801.93), showing persistent selling pressure, but price is directly confronting major S/R support at 1.32247 and the 5-touch Session Low at 1.32209 (Session High at 1.32431). GEX is null. Selling into a key multi-touch support shelf without breakout volume carries high squeeze risk, justifying a HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28159.05 to VAH 28390.85) trading above POC 28264.08. In LONDON_SESSION, price is trading below VWAP 28310.51 while holding just above EMA50 28271.32. Position is mid-channel between ATR upper 28346.54 and lower 28143.23. RVOL is 0.992 with no yellow spikes (noting Dukascopy CFD tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0, but other trend confluence is absent). CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.05 with slope +1.30), showing negligible directional pressure. Price holds S/R support at 28265.71 above Session Low 28151.81, but remains capped under VWAP and Session High 28513.99. GEX is null. Mid-range chop ahead of NY session warrants a HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 49.772 to VAH 50.350) and trading below POC 50.024. In LONDON_SESSION, price is tracking below VWAP 50.177 and below EMA50 50.152. It sits mid-channel within the ATR envelope (49.706 to 50.365). RVOL is 0.957 with no yellow volume spike to confirm breakdown continuation. CVD is BEARISH (-114 with slope -16.66) agreeing with the soft drift, but price is hovering directly over key S/R support at 49.922 and Session Low 49.579, well below Session High 50.783. GEX is null. Without volume expansion below VAL or through support, the setup lacks edge and requires a HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 67782.90 to VAH 70035.28) and trading above POC 68676.09. In LONDON_SESSION, the signal candle wicked above VWAP 69365.54 and rejected, closing below it while remaining below EMA50 69613.70. Price is mid-channel within the ATR envelope (68286.19 to 69598.54). RVOL is 1.065 lacking yellow breakout volume. CVD is BEARISH (-0.03 with slope +0.02), reflecting conflicted order flow. Price rejected VWAP but remains well above Session Low 67549.90 and below Session High 71433.30. Trapped between EMA20 baseline support and VWAP/EMA50 resistance, market structure favors a HOLD.
